children: Needham reiterated their Buy rating on On Holding's stock with a price target of $37.00.
The price target implies an upside of 35.4% from the Sep 17 close of $27.33.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: On Holding is on track to exceed its sales targets significantly, with a projected compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of approximately 30% through 2026, indicating robust demand and effective management strategies.

: The company is expected to maintain gross margins above 65% and achieve an adjusted EBITDA margin between 19.5% and 20%, reflecting strong operational efficiencies and a favorable shift towards direct-to-consumer sales.
